title: Cyberjaya 21K 2026 Review: Malaysia's Tech-City Half Marathon
meta_description: Cyberjaya 21K 2026: August 2 at Rekascape, Cyberjaya. A single-distance half marathon from Tetrad Event Empire — registration now closed.
dek: Set for 2 August 2026 at Rekascape in Cyberjaya, this Tetrad Event Empire production is a focused single-distance 21.1K. Registration is now closed.
verdict: Cyberjaya 21K is a focused, single-distance half marathon in Cyberjaya — Malaysia's planned tech-city with wide roads and modern infrastructure. Organised by Tetrad Event Empire at Rekascape, a commercial precinct in the heart of Cyberjaya's Persiaran APEC corridor. Registration is closed. Cyberjaya's wide boulevards and minimal traffic make for a fast, flat course — a genuine PB opportunity. For runners who missed the 2026 edition, target 2027.

sections.heading: Cyberjaya: Malaysia's Tech City
paragraphs: Cyberjaya's wide, well-maintained boulevards — designed for a planned tech city — provide an excellent running surface with minimal traffic. [1] Rekascape is a commercial precinct on Persiaran APEC. Tetrad Event Empire handles production. Registration is closed.

paragraphs: Registration closed. A fast Cyberjaya half marathon to target for 2027. [1]
